name: Lightning Bolt

header.Components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a crystal rod)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: a bit of fur and a crystal rod

authored_intent: Self-origin 100-foot by 5-foot line; DEX-half Lightning; higher slots add 1d6; preserve directional line selection.

rules.text: A stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you in a direction you choose.
Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.
